# Check green blocks

print(f"\nGreen blocks: {len(greens)}")
for g in greens:
    boundary = g['boundary']
    rows = [r[0] for r in boundary]
    cols = [r[1] for r in boundary]
    print(f"  rows={min(rows)}-{max(rows)} cols={min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Try clicking on first green block

    boundary = g['boundary']

    seg2 = current_frame.segmentation

    print(f"Greens after: {len(greens2)}")

</tool_call>
